recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: NBI to subpoena DPWH officials over flood control projects in Davao City
recentItems.description:
The National Bureau of Investigation has flagged 47 flood control projects in the congressional district of Davao City Rep. Paolo “Pulong” Duterte for further scrutiny, with 51 individuals from three construction firms and government agencies set to receive subpoenas.

Among those to be subpoenaed is the Department of Public Works and Highways Region XI director, as the NBI continues its review of the projects based on documents obtained from the DPWH. — Report from Zyann Ambrosio, ABS-CBN News 

 #ABSCBNNews #LatestNews

recentItems.title: Ombudsman to file graft vs Villars over alleged poor water service
recentItems.description:
The Office of the Ombudsman filed 2 counts of graft and administrative complaints against Senators Mark and Camille Villar, former senators Manny and Cynthia Villar, Paolo Villar, and other local water district officials due to alleged poor water service.

Assistant Ombudsman Mico Clavano said Friday (September 18) the complaints were under preliminary investigation. — Report from Kaxandra Salonga, ABS-CBN News

recentItems.title: LIVE: Metro Manila traffic situation and updates (Afternoon Rush Hour) | September 18, 2026
recentItems.description:
Stay informed before heading out on the road! Here is the latest real-time vehicular flow and road advisories across major thoroughfares in the National Capital Region (NCR).

This broadcast delivers live traffic updates for commuters, motorists, and transport operators navigating critical transit corridors across Metro Manila, including EDSA, C-5 Road, Quezon Avenue, Commonwealth Avenue, Roxas Boulevard, Taft Avenue, and key expressways.

MMDA Unified Vehicular Volume Reduction Program (UVVRP) / Number Coding Scheme:
· Standard Hours: 7:00 AM – 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM – 8:00 PM (Monday to Friday, excluding holidays).
· Standard Window Hours: 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM (Note: Window hours apply on most major roads; Makati City enforces no-window coding).

Daily License Plate Ending Schedule:
· Mondays: 1 & 2
· Tuesdays: 3 & 4
· Wednesdays: 5 & 6
· Thursdays: 7 & 8
· Fridays: 9 & 0
